route_rationale: One coherent MICO-mode rule determines the connected duration.

gold_tasks.question: What determines how long the MICO-mode UE may be kept connected under the stated condition?
gold_tasks.objective: Locate the complete normative rule for Extended Connected Time and its determining inputs.

evidence_units.proposition: The UE may remain connected for an Extended Connected Time so pending downlink signalling or data can be delivered.
The AMF determines Extended Connected Time from local configuration and/or the Maximum Response Time supplied by the UDM.

answer_units.statement: Identify Extended Connected Time as the applicable duration.
State that the AMF derives it from local configuration and/or the UDM-provided Maximum Response Time.

route_rationale: Storage and use are related security requirements for the same credential set inside one UE.

Map Registration Accept and Reject to the resulting RM states and connect them to the cited procedure.
